topic: Why a plumber's Google listing gets views but no calls (Step 3)
title: Set Hours Right | Why Your Plumber Gets Views but No Calls
description: Set Hours Right. From our full video: Why Your Plumber Gets Views but No Calls.

scenes.narration: Step 3: Use business hours and attributes to match intent. If you do emergency calls, mark '24/7' or 'On-site services.' If you don’t, don’t claim it. Honesty avoids angry customers and false clicks.

Example: Nail salon with late slots. Add a 'Late appointments' attribute and show evening photos of the salon. Add the exact hours for late nights. People searching after work will click and call if they see availability.
